title: Bahia worker telemetry parsing and pressure assessment
intent: Turn current Kind 10100 worker telemetry advertisements into canonical Worker telemetry and Bahia-owned pressure assessments, then publish internal telemetry observed events for downstream monitors.
observed_behavior: internal/domain/worker.go already defines WorkerTelemetry and WorkerPressureAssessment fields and enums.
internal/repository/pg_worker.go persists telemetry and pressure JSONB and guards worker upserts by last_advertisement_at.
internal/adapters/nostr/processor.go previously parsed extended content fields but did not parse telemetry, assess pressure, reload canonical worker state, or publish telemetry observed events.
intended_behavior: Kind 10100 content telemetry is parsed into Worker.Telemetry.
Bahia computes a deterministic pressure assessment from telemetry, queue, and standby state using the resource pressure plan thresholds.
The processor reloads canonical worker state after upsert, persists pressure, and emits worker.telemetry.observed only when the stored row is not newer than the ingested advertisement.
